lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement follows a rectilinear pattern with approximately 4-5 visible columns of spots within the mid-flank section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a coordinate-like grid on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper flank. These features exhibit a distinct luminance gradient, with high-intensity light on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, linear reddish-brown mark is visible on the mid-upper flank, posterior to the gill area. There is also an irregular cluster of white depigmented pixels near the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller high-luminance spots along its proximal leading edge, transitioning to larger, more sparse spots toward the distal tip.
